answer_1.quote: We utilize a dense image captioning network, DenseCap to generate rich referring expressions of the objects that includes self-attributes such as color, material, shape, etc., and various relational attributes.

answer_2.quote: We primarily use WER metric for evaluation. We also show a relative metric, namely word error rate reduction (WERR). Additionally, we use a highly pessimistic metric, namely transcription accuracy (TA), which computes an exact match accuracy of the entire transcription.
